name: blog-writer
description: Interactive writing partner for technical and meta-technical blogs. Two slash commands for A/B testing: /blog-writer:write-blog (multi-phase — brief, angle, outline, section-by-section draft, editorial, research, title, cover) and /blog-writer:write (streamlined — one research-informed Q&A batch, one clean draft, then an @bw annotation loop). Individual skills from the multi-phase flow also activate via trigger phrases. Preserves your voice; author-controlled throughout.
